source: Reviewer-authored synthetic caller example; no dependency implementation or actual upstream caller supplied.
functional_contract_extension: Descriptor lists may contain balanced #if/#ifdef/#ifndef/#elif/#else/#endif groups with optional comma-prefixed descriptors. Preserve conditions for table entries and locals and keep later unconditional indices correct under every setting. Never evaluate flags in the converter. Unsupported shapes must fail explicitly.
implementation: Conditional directives emitted into matching local enum, allowed_args table, and writable output-local declarations. Enum automatic numbering supplies descriptor-order indices after conditional sections.
supported_shape: Complete descriptors separated by commas valid in every branch, including nested conditionals, elif and else. No preprocessor flag evaluation.
explicit_rejections: Conditional groups within an individual descriptor or parser prefix parameter
A possible empty descriptor list, missing comma, or trailing comma
Repeated argument identifiers across the full invocation, including mutually exclusive branches
